headline: On Jul 22 Secretary of State Rubio and Foreign Minister Wang Yi talked to prepare for Xi's planned Sep 24 visit; Taiwan was on the agenda and Reuters reports no outcome (#3061).

On Jul 23 China announced two days of live-fire drills near Dongshan Island, Fujian, within about 7 miles of the Chinese coast (#3062), and the Philippines accused China of using water cannon at Scarborough Shoal (#3063). Reuters gives no stated reason for the drills, so they are treated as background.

Trump and Xi met in Beijing on May 14 (#3060). The last Taiwan arms sale in the log is the $11.1 billion package of Dec 18, 2025 (#3056); China answered with counter-sanctions and the Justice Mission 2025 drills (#3057, #3058).
